_comment: The drift signals of Book 20, Chapter 12 ('Drift detection'), and what the kit compares to find them. 'watch' lists, per read in config/calls.json, the properties compared between two exports (items are matched by name); 'raiseWhen' raises a difference to a named signal when its new value (and, where given, its old value) matches. Severity follows Book 13, Chapter 06's ladder: P1 halts and alerts and a named role decides; P2 goes to the platform owner within one business day; info is reported, not failed. The properties named are the cmdlets' parameter names as Learn gives them; Learn doesn't list the cmdlets' output properties, so check them against your first export.

enforcement.title: A DLP or auto-labeling policy changed mode
enforcement.action: explain it with a change ticket or put the policy back in the mode its stage says

enforcement-off.title: A policy left enforcement (out of Enable)
enforcement-off.action: enforcement is silently off: restore it or record the decision

rule.title: A DLP rule's action or exception changed
rule.action: check the exception register and the rule's decision record

rights.title: A label's encryption or rights changed
rights.action: content is re-protected as users next open it: restore or approve

published.title: A label or scope changed in a label policy
published.action: users may no longer apply the label, or defaults stop applying

superuser.title: The super user feature is on, or a super user was added
superuser.action: a standing ability to decrypt everything: disable it unless a recovery ticket is open

audit-off.title: Unified audit ingestion turned off
audit-off.action: every other Purview signal goes dark: turn it on and treat it as an incident

retention.title: An audit retention policy changed
retention.action: the evidence's reach changed: check it with the records officer

mail.title: A mail flow rule's state, mode or template changed

copilot.title: A Copilot DLP policy or rule changed
copilot.action: labeled content may be back in Copilot responses
